name: Accurex Solutions Pvt. Ltd
india_angle: Accurex Solutions Pvt. Ltd is an Indian company established in 1987, providing solutions from design to final product with a focus on semiconductor backend processes.
summary: Accurex Solutions Pvt. Ltd specializes in providing advanced backend process solutions for semiconductor manufacturers, covering wafer preparation, dicing, die attach, wire bonding, encapsulation, and testing. They offer a curated lineup of globally trusted technologies to enhance process efficiency and product reliability.
